name: docling_convert
description: Convert existing documents to layout-aware Markdown, structured Docling JSON and plain text using an optional self-hosted Docling Serve service. Use for extracting tables or preserving document reading order from PDFs, scanned PDFs/images, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, Markdown and CSV; OCR is optional and enabled by default. Accepts a Stash reference or policy-approved local file on Jarvis; saves full exports to Stash and returns a bounded text excerpt plus page/table counts. Async task_id is preserved for job/collect recovery; never upload again after an unknown result. Prefer pdf_read for quick searchable-PDF text, page rendering or PDF manipulation; document_ocr is the separate OVIS service; analyze_image is for general photo questions. This tool converts existing content, not image generation or PDF creation. After a Web background admission, wait for automatic delivery. Its Jarvis job_id is different from Docling task_id; never pass it to job/collect or submit another conversion to poll. Example requests: "Convert this PDF to Markdown", "Extract tables as JSON", "Turn a scanned document into plain text".

action.description: convert uploads one existing document; status checks readiness; job checks a prior task; collect waits for and saves its outputs without uploading again.

stash_ref.description: Existing uploaded document stash:// reference. For convert use exactly one of stash_ref or file_path.

file_path.description: Policy-permitted local document path on the Jarvis host. Prefer stash_ref for Web attachments.

task_id.description: Exact UUID-style Docling task_id from the provider response or saved docling-task.json. Required for job/collect. A 32-character Jarvis background job_id belongs to the Background Tasks UI; wait for automatic delivery instead. Never invent IDs or resubmit uncertain work.

formats.description: convert output formats; defaults to all three. JSON is native Docling layout/tables/provenance, not a user-defined business schema.

do_ocr.description: Run OCR on bitmap content. Default true; use false for searchable documents without scans.

force_ocr.description: Replace existing text with OCR. Default false; requires do_ocr true.

page_start.description: Optional first PDF page; defaults to 1 when page_end is supplied.

page_end.description: Optional inclusive last PDF page. Must be >= page_start. Narrow ranges help with long documents.

output_name.description: Safe basename without extension for saved outputs; default converted-document.

availability.setup_hint: Set DOCLING_BASE_URL and DOCLING_API_KEY for an existing Docling Serve service in the selected mode ENV. See docs/tools/docling-tool/README.md.
